name: latency-chart
title: Latency Chart
description: Response times by percentile and sample.
usage: <LatencyChart title="API latency" unit="ms" samples={[{ label: "10:00", p50: 18, p95: 42 }, { label: "10:05", p50: 20, p95: null }]} />
useCases: After a release, an engineer compares median API latency with p95 to spot slowdowns affecting a subset of requests.
During incident review, an on-call engineer steps through samples and distinguishes a missing measurement from a measured zero.
task: Compare p50 and p95 latency over time.
behavior: Pass samples in chronological order. A null value means no observation and zero is a measured value.
